description: This file contains utility functions related to internationalization, hashing, environment variable configuration, and text normalization for a broader software project, possibly involving localization or content hashing.

methods.name: cacheNamespace
methods.description: Generates a cache namespace string incorporating workflow version, engine name, provider, and model.

methods.name: cacheKey
methods.description: Creates a SHA256 hash-based cache key from namespace, source/target languages, segment ID, and text hash.

methods.name: hashText
methods.description: Returns a SHA256 hash of the normalized input text.

methods.name: hashBytes
methods.description: Returns a SHA256 hash of the given byte array.

methods.name: normalizeText
methods.description: Normalizes text by trimming and collapsing whitespace to a single space.

methods.name: docsPiProvider
methods.description: Determines the provider (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic) based on environment variables.

methods.name: docsPiModel
methods.description: Selects the model name based on provider and environment variables.

methods.name: segmentID
methods.description: Generates a segment ID string composed of relative path and a truncated hash.

methods.name: splitWhitespace
methods.description: Splits a string into leading whitespace, core text, and trailing whitespace.

methods.name: isWhitespace
methods.description: Checks if a byte is whitespace.

methods.name: fatal
methods.description: Logs an error to standard error and exits the program.
